title: Law to study ferry service for City Island
summary: This bill would require the Department of Transportation, working with other city agencies, to study the feasibility of new ferry service to City Island, including possible landing sites, costs and environmental effects. The Commissioner would have to report findings to the Mayor and Council within one year, and if a suitable site is found, begin construction and launch service within another year. It was heard alongside similar ferry bills for Canarsie Pier, Willets Point and West 125th Street at an October 20, 2026 Council hearing.
